cohort: The study included 696 women scheduled for cesarean section, randomized into a control group and an intervention group.
finding: The metoclopramide group experienced significantly shorter intervals to first flatus, defecation, feeling of hunger, feeding, and ambulation, and also reported less bloating compared to the control group.
mod_finding: Metoclopramide significantly shortened the recovery time for various post-operative functions (flatus, defecation, hunger, feeding, ambulation) and reduced bloating after cesarean section.
